Each column shows one query, with reference, query, ground truth, and method outputs arranged vertically.
Both O-SCD variants and our pixel and full outputs are shown.
Green, orange, and pink denote correct detections, false positives, and missed changes, respectively.

Figure 7:Additional qualitative comparisons on PASLCD.Examples are from Printing area, Lounge, Lunch room, and another view of Cantina.
The layout and colours follow Figure6.
Refinement recovers the cabinet region in Printing area, while false positives near the ceiling in Lounge and missed object regions in Lunch room remain.
Numbers report per-frame foreground IoU.

Figure 8:Qualitative comparison on CCS3D.Examples are from Livingroom, Desk, Bookcase, and Bedroom.
Rows and colours follow Figure6.
Ground truth is the union of pre- and post-state masks, as in Table2.
Our full method reduces excess responses around displaced objects in Livingroom and Desk and on unchanged regions in Bedroom; boundary errors remain in Bookcase.
Numbers report per-frame foreground IoU.
